name: DKP exchange live-pair valuation
summary: The DKP exchange contract (unverified) sizes DKP payouts from the DKP/USDT pair's live token balances. The attacker flash-swapped nearly all USDT out of the pair, called exchange at the depressed DKP price for a large DKP payout, repaid the flash swap and sold the DKP into the pair.
notes: The victim is the exchange's DKP inventory; DKP has no market price, so the DKP the attacker received is valued at the USDT it realised selling it (ref 0x2d31e45d, rule 12). The referral share went to a protocol-funded address and the pair's flash fee is not netted (rule 11).
No owner setter or configuration change exists between deployment and the exploit.
